Check twice. Print once.

PIXEL CHECKS + AI REVIEW
A CLEARER FINAL CHECK

From proof to print.

  1. Add your artwork. Select one print PDF and the approved JPEG proofs.
  2. Pair the pages. Match each JPEG to a PDF page. For best results, proofs should have the same crop and orientation.
  3. Choose your checks. Pixel sensitivity controls local highlights. Enable AI reports for plain-language artwork comparisons.
  4. Review the result. Read the AI table, inspect the overlay and differences, and export a combined report.

Pixel checks run locally at up to 1,600 pixels. Optional AI reviews send the original reference preview and a separately rendered PDF page, each up to 2,000 pixels, through Netlify to OpenAI. The PDF file itself is not sent. The app does not save the images on the server. OpenAI’s API data policies apply. AI can miss or misdescribe changes; low-resolution details and print colour accuracy need human checking. This is not a prepress certification.
